name: molly-personal-assistant
description: Molly — Yi's local-first, multi-surface personal assistant.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n desktop,gateway -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:desktop" "npm run dev:gateway"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @molly/contracts && npm run build -w @molly/core
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @molly/gateway && npm run build -w @molly/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @molly/contracts && npm run build -w @molly/core && npm run typecheck -w @molly/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @molly/core && npm run typecheck -w @molly/gateway && npm run typecheck -w @molly/desktop
